text: こ　こっちを　じっと　みてて　それで　マヨ　こわくて　かえれなく　なっちゃって…

structure.jp: こ　こっちを　じっと　みてて
structure.en: i-it was staring this way, and

structure.jp: かえれなく　なっちゃって…
structure.en: ended up unable to go home...

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.span: かえれなく　なっちゃって
patterns.explanation: A word ending in い, including ない, changes to く before なる to say things become that way. かえれない 'can't go home' becomes かえれなく　なる = 'become unable to go home'.

patterns.name: 〜て (reason)
patterns.explanation: The て-form of a feeling word gives the reason for what comes next. こわくて = 'being scared, so'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちゃう is the casual form of てしまう, which says something ended up happening and you are unhappy about it. なっちゃって = 'it ended up becoming so'.
